newsitem.title: JAPAN: McDonald's Japan unit plans tie-up with Nippon Oil.
newsitem.headline: McDonald's Japan unit plans tie-up with Nippon Oil.

text.p: McDonald's Co (Japan) Ltd, a unit of McDonald's Corp, said on Thursday that it plans to open outlets at gasoline stations operated by Japan's top refiner Nippon Oil Co Ltd.
The Japanese unit plans to open five to six such outlets next year, a company spokesman said.
In August, it announced that it would open an outlet at a gasoline stand run by another Japanese refiner, Idemitsu Kosan Co Ltd, on a trial basis.
Comments were not immediately available from Nippon Oil.

McDonald's Japanese unit already plans to increase its outlets to 5,000 in Japan by the end of 2000 but the planned tie-up with Nippon Oil is expected to help it achieve the target earlier, the unit's spokesman said.
Currently the Japanese unit has 1,915 outlets.
